notes:
LacTracker is now part of LacBench, with EmStat Control and BathBot. Batches as production writes them, sensor design, and exports only into _data.

- Batch is now text, as on the batch and in the manufacturing database: 42, S1, G2, Medistri_prep, and 0 for bare electrodes.
- New Design (e.g. XIAB, DIRS) and Surface (painted / unpainted) fields in LacTracker and EmStat Control. Batch 0 needs the design.
- New "Sensor not identified" checkbox: when nobody knows which sensor was used, tick it instead of typing a guess. Batch and sensor are required otherwise.
- Export goes only into a folder called _data; any other folder is refused (LacTracker used to warn only).
- Files follow sensor-json 2.0 and sensor-csv 1.0.
